item.title: Atlantic Tropical Weather Outlook
item.description:

Tropical Weather Outlook
NWS National Hurricane Center Miami FL
800 AM EDT Thu Sep 10 2026

For the North Atlantic...Caribbean Sea and the Gulf of America:

Active Systems:
The National Hurricane Center is issuing advisories on Hurricane
Fay, located over the central Atlantic.

1. Central Tropical Atlantic (AL95):
Showers and thunderstorms associated with a tropical wave have
become better organized. A tropical depression is likely to form
within the next day or two.
* Formation chance through 48 hours...medium...60 percent.
* Formation chance through 7 days...high...80 percent.

2. Eastern Tropical Atlantic:
A tropical wave is expected to move off the west coast of Africa
this weekend. Some slow development is possible thereafter.
* Formation chance through 48 hours...low...near 0 percent.
* Formation chance through 7 days...low...20 percent.

$$
Forecaster Blake
